topics.title: Z.ai's GLM-5.3-Flash undercuts the big labs on price
topics.why: A free, MIT-licensed model that beats its predecessor at a tenth of the price shows how fast good AI is getting cheaper -- worth knowing before you renew any paid tool subscription.

topics.title: Anthropic could IPO as soon as October at a $2 trillion valuation
topics.why: When a company built on API subscriptions is valued above most of the S&P 500, that's a real signal of how much enterprises are already betting AI tools stay core to how work gets done.

topics.title: 90% of execs say 3 years of AI hasn't moved headcount or output
topics.why: A useful reality check against AI panic -- good ammo if AI comes up in a headcount or productivity conversation at your job.
